correctness.rationale: On antipodal quotient G=F2^n/<1> with n=4m≥12, distance min(w,n−w) is invariant under representatives. The even-weight parity character gives the Fourier eigenvalue S_h(p)/2, h=n/2 even. Exact alternating-binomial Abel summation expresses S_h(p)=−2 Σ_{w=0}^{h−1}(−1)^w binom(2h−1,w)[(w+1)^p−w^p]. Pairing consecutive even and odd w, the rigorous Δ_{w+1}/Δ_w≥w/(w+1) makes every pair positive; keeping final pair yields S_h(p)>0 by p=u_h=2(h+1)(h−1)²/(binom(2h,h)(h−3))<1, hence strict upper β<u_h. For all exponents 0<p≤(2^{n+1}log h)^−1, each off-diagonal d^p perturbation from discrete metric J−I is bounded and its operator norm <1/2, guaranteeing strict CND; combines to β≥this lower value. Stirling yields both n-th-root bases→1/2. Independent exact binomial Abel and bound calculations for n=12,16,20 corroborate (not establish) the infinite argument. Normalization of full versus quotient character transform checked.
residual_risks: Finite crosschecks alone do not prove the infinite or continuum domain; the stated analytic proof was separately reconstructed.
